title: James is the star food tour guide
text:
Excellent tour. Our guide James was awesome. Being a chef prior, he was able to explain subtle nuances to everything we tasted. He explained market philosophy and gave an in depth review of the history of El born and Barcelonetta. He took us to traditional small neighborhood rest which are still managed by families.and we ended up with a traditional seafood paella which was so tasty.
All in all well with the money
author: kulatungasudhira

title: A tour of the local tapas culture from a local guide
text: Alexandra was the perfect guide to local cuisine and culture. Knowledgeable, entertaining, personable, and most importantantly - fun! A true tour of the local gastronomical culture of Barcelona.
author: B131RWjoshb
